purpose: observational dataset, not optimization or speed gain qualification
hardware: Apple M5, 24 GiB, AC, applications open

natural.cache_reset: target semantic state reset, expert LFU weights/frequency persist; counts recorded each phase
natural.phase_snapshots: VM and process resource counters outside prefill/decode clocks
natural.raw: nested host spans per layer/component, route IDs/slots/hits/cold union, SSD per-job worker intervals and returned bytes, output step intervals, MTP stage intervals
natural.release_controls: one fresh release bridge warmup+measured128 before each natural cell, same fixed binary49, exact golden parity; no claim unit/release difference is pure logging overhead
natural.overhead: unit trace_1..3 vs adjacent untraced controls, descriptive with cache/VM/system differences; >10% or drift>5% flagged and retained

fenced.timing_contract: component completion wall time incl host launch/scheduler/wait; nested times overlap; no exclusive GPU claim
fenced.parity: every emitted ID and final full finite 248320 logits plus all target semantic states byte exact vs untraced oracle, MTP head alignment; physical independent oracle and MTP pair/session tests first

quality_first.small_new_profile_cases: OFF then MTP, cache3 MAIN17 outputs, natural then fenced, full logits/states parity and nonempty trace validation
quality_first.error_tests: scope nesting, no-op disabled, finite/nonempty/count validation, interrupted/silent/nonzero subprocesses, partial outputs never validated, disk failed partial reads and worker joining

unavailable: per-kernel exclusive GPU counters without validated timestamps
physical NVMe traffic attributed to a model
separate_followups: DFlash2/DSpark and long context deferred until primary eight-cell natural/fenced matrix is complete; do not silently substitute them
